other_text: A DOCUMENTARY ABOUT THE FAMOUS TREE AT THE BOSHAM VILLAGE, ENGLAND, AND THE LEGENDARY GHOST THAT HAUNTS IT. WRITTEN AND DIRECTED BY JULIANNE SMITH. PRODUCED BY THE BOSHAM FILM CO. STARRING ELIZABETH STONE.
